label: Conference programme topic (native)
definition: The topic exactly as reported by the conference programme metadata (theme_ru/theme_en/session_title in pipeline/schema.py)
inclusion: Any theme/session label taken verbatim from the source programme

label: Nāgarī group thread topic (native)
definition: The topic as it can be read off a closed Google Group thread subject line
inclusion: Thread subject lines and any group-assigned label

label: VK ORS hashtag (native)
definition: A self-applied hashtag on a VK wall post; the page author's own classification
inclusion: Any `#hashtag` token extracted by vk-ors's insights.py

label: INDOLOGY-L subject keyword (native)
definition: A topic term derivable from an INDOLOGY-L message Subject: header or the archive's own atlas_topic_profiles
inclusion: Subject-line keywords and archive-assigned topic profile labels

label: BVP native category (native; not yet acquired)
definition: Placeholder for whatever native category scheme the BVP source turns out to expose once acquired (H1896)
inclusion: No BVP data exists yet; this row documents the namespace only

label: Other (native)
definition: A recognizable native topic that does not fit an existing per-source row above.
inclusion: Any coherent native-vocabulary topic outside the rows above.
exclusion: Anything that instead fits an existing per-source row.

label: Unknown (native)
definition: Insufficient evidence to assign any native topic.
exclusion: Any record where a native topic could be determined.
